title: glechoma lagopsis
intro: Glechoma lagopsis, commonly known as Creeping Sage or Blue Spurred Speedwell, is a flowering plant that belongs to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This herb is known for its various health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, relieve stress and anxiety, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Glechoma lagopsis include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and sedative effects, which can help to calm the nervous system and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
